How can we make city transportation safer? 
In this project you will: 

• Explore different safety rules that are linked to city transportation and describe how some of them can be improved
• Create and program a device to improve city safety
• Test your program and show how safety has been improved with your device
• Share your program and ideas
Get inspired by the Design Library base models to build your own solution to this project.
